text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy's Heroic Tale
text_block_list.text:
Zenno Rob Roy brilliantly claimed the 
prestigious Autumn Shield. The spectators 
erupted into cheers at the sight.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy's Heroic Tale
text_block_list.text:
The next target is the Japan Cup. I swore 
to achieve the Autumn Senior Triple Crown 
without fail and become a hero.
